svg.text: Long trip (T = 1.5 half-periods): the real dial blows up; the imaginary dial still picks the classical path
where the path is at the halfway time (offset from classical)
real dial: weight GROWS away from
the classical path → the sum diverges
where the path is at the halfway time
imaginary dial: fast wiggles cancel everywhere
except the slow stretch at the classical path (stationary phase)
Harmonic oscillator from x = 0 to x = 1, ħ = 0.02. Classical point marked green. Checks R1–R5 run the same test at T = 0.6 and 1.4 half-periods.
